Below is the complete **Visual Constitution** and **Asset Taxonomy** — the foundation every future diagram must conform to.

---

# Systems Visualization Constitution v1.0.0

## I. Design Philosophy

**Mission:** Every diagram is an explanatory instrument, not decoration. A viewer must grasp the system in **under 5 seconds** at 1080p and remain legible at 480p thumbnail scale.

| Principle | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| One idea per diagram | Split at 12+ nodes |
| Hierarchy over decoration | Space, grouping, and stroke weight carry meaning |
| Semantic color only | Color encodes role, never aesthetics |
| Failure paths included | When the concept involves reliability or replay |
| Consistent shapes | Same role = same shape across all videos |

**Forbidden:** gradients, glow/3D, rainbow nodes, decorative icons without legend, crossing edges without rerouting, pure black backgrounds.

---

## II. Color System

**Background:** `#0B0F14` (base) · `#111820` (elevated panels/subgraphs) · optional 24px dot grid at 4% opacity

**Text:** `#E8EDF4` (primary) · `#8B9BB4` (secondary/edge labels) · `#5A6478` (legend/muted)

**Accents:** `#00D4FF` cyan (live path/events) · `#3B82F6` blue (agents/services) · `#A855F7` purple (memory/context)

**Semantic:** `#22D3A5` success/committed · `#FBBF24` pending/buffer · `#F87171` error/divergence · `#64748B` external/archived

**Strokes:** `#2A3444` at rest · `#00D4FF` when highlighted

### Semantic Role → Color Mapping

| System Role | Token | Apply When |
|-------------|-------|------------|
| Agent / Service / Worker | `accent.blue` | Compute, orchestrators, LLM calls |
| Memory / Context / Embedding | `accent.purple` | Stores, retrievers, RAG, context windows |
| Live Data / Event / Stream | `accent.cyan` | Events, messages, hot path |
| Persistent Store / Commit | `semantic.success` | Event store, WAL, committed state |
| Buffer / Pending | `semantic.warning` | Uncommitted, in-flight |
| Error / Divergence | `semantic.error` | Failed replay, non-deterministic branch |
| External / Legacy | `semantic.neutral` | Third-party APIs, human input |

---

## III. Typography

| Level | Family | Size | Weight | Convention |
|-------|--------|------|--------|------------|
| Diagram Title | Inter / SF Pro Display | 28–32px | 600 | Title Case |
| Subgraph Title | Inter | 18px | 600 | Title Case |
| Node Label | Inter / JetBrains Mono | 14–16px | 500 | PascalCase or kebab-case |
| Edge Label | JetBrains Mono | 11–12px | 400 | camelCase / snake_case |
| Annotation | Inter | 11px | 400 | Sentence case |
| Legend | Inter | 10px | 500 | UPPER keys |
| Timestamp / Seq | JetBrains Mono | 10px | 400 | Tabular nums |

**Constraints:** Node labels ≤ 3 words or 24 chars. Edge labels ≤ 20 chars. Overflow → abbreviation + legend entry.

---

## IV. Node Shape Library (Universal)

| Shape | Semantic Role | Mermaid | D2 |
|-------|---------------|---------|-----|
| Rounded Rectangle | Service / Process / Agent | `([Label])` | rectangle, radius 8 |
| Stadium / Pill | Pipeline Stage | `([Label])` | rectangle, radius 24 |
| Cylinder | Database / Event Store / Memory | `[(Label)]` | cylinder |
| Hexagon | Deterministic Engine / Reducer | `{{Label}}` | hexagon |
| Diamond | Decision / Gate / Policy | `{Label}` | diamond |
| Parallelogram | External I/O / API / Tool | `[/Label/]` | parallelogram |
| Double Rectangle | Boundary / Context / Tenant | `[[Label]]` | double-border |
| Subgraph Frame | Subsystem / Bounded Context | `subgraph` | container |
| Small Circle | Event / Message / Token | `((Label))` | circle, 48px |
| Document | Snapshot / Checkpoint / Export | page shape | page |

**Rule:** Shape encodes responsibility. Never swap shapes for the same role across diagrams.

---

## V. Edge & Arrow Library

| Style | Meaning | Mermaid | Visual Weight |
|-------|---------|---------|---------------|
| Solid → | Sync call / direct dependency | `-->` | Primary |
| Dashed → | Async / fire-and-forget | `-.->` | Secondary |
| Dotted → | Optional / conditional | `-..->` | Tertiary |
| Thick → | Hot path / primary data flow | `==>` | Emphasis |
| Bidirectional ↔ | Shared state / CRDT | `<-->` | Special |
| Labeled edge | Payload, command, topic | `-->|evt:Created|` | Required when ambiguous |
| Feedback loop ↺ | Replay, retry, self-correction | curved self-edge | Accent color |
| Timeline axis → | Causality / ordering | sequenceDiagram | Time flows L→R |

---

## VI. Layout & Composition Rules

1. Primary read direction: **L→R** for flows; **T→B** for layers
2. Safe canvas: **1920×1080** full frame; **1920×800** for lower-third overlay
3. Minimum spacing: **48px** horizontal, **40px** vertical between nodes
4. Max hierarchy depth: **3** nested subgraphs
5. Legend: bottom-right or top-left — never overlap the hot path
6. Reorder nodes before adding edge bends
7. **One accent color** per diagram moment
8. Empty space is signal — group related nodes, isolate failure paths

---

## VII. Diagram Type Taxonomy (DT-XX)

| ID | Type | Purpose | Max Nodes | Default Layout |
|----|------|---------|-----------|----------------|
| DT-01 | System Context | One-glance boundary map | 7 | Radial or horizontal tiers |
| DT-02 | Layered Architecture | Vertical responsibility stack | 12 | Top-down 3–5 layers |
| DT-03 | Data Flow | Transform pipeline | 9 | Left-to-right |
| DT-04 | Event Timeline | Causality & ordering | 8 | Horizontal timeline |
| DT-05 | State Machine | Valid transitions | 6 | Circular or layered |
| DT-06 | Sequence / Interaction | Request-response choreography | 5 | sequenceDiagram |
| DT-07 | CQRS / Command-Query Split | Write vs read paths | 10 | Bifurcated fork |
| DT-08 | Event Sourcing Loop | Append → project → query | 8 | Closed loop, store center |
| DT-09 | Replay / Determinism | Same input → same output | 7 | Parallel paths converging |
| DT-10 | Memory Hierarchy | Context tiers & eviction | 9 | Pyramid or nested frames |
| DT-11 | Agent Orchestration | Planner → workers → merge | 11 | Hub-and-spoke or DAG |
| DT-12 | Local-First Sync | Offline → merge → converge | 9 | Multi-node sync edges |
| DT-13 | Distributed Cognition | Multi-agent shared state | 10 | Mesh with memory bus |
| DT-14 | Before / After | Migration or refactor delta | 6 | Split panel |
| DT-15 | Failure & Recovery | Error path + replay fix | 8 | Branch with return loop |

**Rule:** One primary DT-XX per concept. Split diagrams before exceeding maxNodes.

---

| AC-01 | Core Primitives | Nodes, edges, frames, legends | Every diagram |

| AC-03 | Memory Patterns | Working, episodic, semantic, vector, graph | Memory & context |
| AC-04 | Event Sourcing Patterns | Aggregate, projector, snapshot, stream | ES & CQRS |

| AC-06 | Orchestration Patterns | DAG, queue, fan-out, saga, checkpoint | Workflow engines |
| AC-07 | Local-First Patterns | CRDT, sync engine, conflict resolver | Edge & offline |
| AC-08 | Context Engineering | Window, compressor, retriever, injector | Prompt & RAG |
| AC-09 | Observability & Trace | Span, log, metric, trace replay | Debug & ops |
| AC-10 | Comparison Frames | vs panels, tradeoff matrices | Decision & critique |

---

## IX. Per-Concept Deliverable Schema (9 Mandatory Slots)

Every future concept diagram ships this bundle **before** rendering:

|---|-------------|------------|
| 1 | **Diagram Title** | ≤8 words; names the system, not the tutorial |
| 2 | **Diagram Purpose** | One sentence: what question this answers in <5s |
| 3 | **Diagram Type** | One DT-XX; no hybrid without declared primary |
| 4 | **Mermaid Version** | Themed init block + flowchart/sequence; max 40 lines |
| 5 | **D2 Version** | Same semantics; containers + shared classes |
| 6 | **SVG Rendering Recommendations** | Dimensions, font embed, stroke, export DPI |

| 7 | **Constraints > Preferences** | Hard limits override taste |

| Failure Mode | Constitutional Response |
|--------------|-------------------------|
| Premature implementation | Delayed Execution Engine — default WAIT |
| Architectural drift | Governance gates + replay requirements |
| Hidden assumptions | Mandatory assumption registry in every thesis |

| Unverified reasoning | Epistemic labels on every claim |

All reasoning must be epistemically labeled:

| Label | Definition | Acceptable Use |
|-------|------------|----------------|
| **KNOWN** | Verified with reproducible evidence | Decisions, execution |
| **INFERRED** | Logically derived from KNOWN facts | Planning with caveats |
| **UNKNOWN** | Acknowledged gap | Triggers research or experiment |
| **SPECULATIVE** | Hypothesis without sufficient evidence | Experiment design only |

**Rule:** SPECULATIVE claims cannot authorize execution.

Every decision record must contain:

1. **Decision ID** (DEC-XXX)

3. **Central claim** — what are we deciding?
4. **Alternatives considered** — minimum two

**Rule:** Decisions without rejected alternatives are incomplete.

# Clarification Protocol v1.0.0

Every proposal must pass all eight stages before execution authorization.

**Default outcome if any stage fails:** `WAIT`

---

## Stage 1 — Problem

| Field | Required | Pass Criteria |
|-------|----------|---------------|
| Problem statement | Yes | One sentence, falsifiable |
| Scope | Yes | Explicit in/out boundaries |
| Stakeholders | Yes | Named owner + affected parties |
| Success criteria | Yes | Measurable or observable |

**Block if:** Problem is a solution in disguise, owner is unnamed, or success criteria are vague.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/01-problem.md`

---

## Stage 2 — Thesis

| Field | Required | Pass Criteria |
|-------|----------|---------------|
| Central claim | Yes | Single declarative sentence |
| Supporting claims | Yes | ≥2, each independently testable |
| Assumptions | Yes | Explicit list, none hidden |

**Block if:** Central claim contains "and" joining unrelated ideas, or assumptions exceed supporting evidence count.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/02-thesis.md`

---

## Stage 3 — Constraints

Enumerate all binding constraints:

| Category | Examples |
|----------|----------|
| Technical | Latency, compatibility, determinism |
| Organizational | Team size, approval chains |
| Financial | Budget ceiling |
| Operational | Uptime, support burden |
| Temporal | Deadlines, sequencing |

**Block if:** Any category marked "none" without justification, or constraints contradict Stage 1 success criteria.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/03-constraints.md`

---

## Stage 4 — Dependencies

| Type | Required Analysis |
|------|-------------------|
| Upstream | What must exist before this works |
| Downstream | What depends on this output |
| Hidden | Implicit couplings, shared state, human dependencies |

**Block if:** Hidden dependencies list is empty (likely incomplete) or upstream deps are unverified.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/04-dependencies.md`

---

## Stage 5 — Failure Modes

Use `cos/frameworks/failure-analysis.md` taxonomy. Minimum one per category where applicable:

- Technical failure
- Human failure
- Process failure
- State corruption
- Replay failure

**Block if:** Failure modes are only symptoms ("it breaks") without root cause class.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/05-failures.md`

---

## Stage 6 — Verification

| Question | Required Answer |
|----------|-----------------|
| How will we know this is true? | Specific observable signal |
| How will we know it is false? | Falsification criteria |
| Who verifies? | Named role |
| When? | Trigger or schedule |

**Block if:** Only positive verification defined (confirmation bias), or verifier is same as proposer without secondary review.

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/06-verification.md`

---

## Stage 7 — Experiment

| Field | Required |
|-------|----------|
| Smallest test | Minimum scope to learn |
| Lowest risk validation | Cheapest safe check |
| Fastest falsification | Quickest path to disprove |

**Waivable only if:** Decision reversibility is REVERSIBLE and cost of experiment exceeds decision cost (documented in DEC-XXX).

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/07-experiment.md`

Execution approval requires:

- [ ] Stages 1–7 complete
- [ ] Delayed Execution Engine status: `CLEAR` (see `cos/engines/delayed-execution.md`)
- [ ] Governance review passed (see `cos/checklists/execution-approval.md`)

**Output artifact:** `proposals/{id}/08-execution-approval.md`

# Delayed Execution Engine v1.0.0

## Principle

The default state of every proposal is:

```text
WAIT
```

not

```text
BUILD
```

Execution is the exception. Delay is the safeguard.

---

## Engine States

| State | Meaning | Allowed Actions |
|-------|---------|-----------------|
| **WAIT** | Default. Insufficient clarity or verification | Clarify, research, experiment |
| **BLOCKED** | Active blocker identified | Resolve blocker only |
| **CLEAR** | All gates passed | Execution may be authorized |
| **EXECUTING** | Approved work in progress | Monitor, verify |
| **COMPLETE** | Verified done | Archive, reflect |
| **REVISE** | Verification failed | Return to appropriate stage |

---

## Automatic BLOCK Triggers

The engine enters `BLOCKED` when any condition is true:

| Trigger | Detection Signal | Return Stage |
|---------|------------------|--------------|
| Requirements unclear | Success criteria fail Stage 1 review | 1 |
| Assumptions exceed evidence | Assumption count > KNOWN evidence count | 2 |
| State incomplete | Required state artifacts missing | 4 |
| Dependencies unknown | Hidden deps list empty or "TBD" | 4 |
| Verification missing | No falsification criteria | 6 |
| Replay impossible | No audit path from inputs to conclusion | 6 |
| Tool-driven decision | Rationale cites tool output as sole authority | 2 |
| Context collapse risk | Reasoning depth > externalized state depth | 2 |
| Unowned problem | No stakeholder owner | 1 |

---

## Execution Justification Requirement

To transition `WAIT → CLEAR`, author must complete:

```markdown
## Execution Justification (required)

1. **Why now?** (not "because we can")
2. **What happens if we wait?** (cost of delay — must be evidence-based)
3. **What is the smallest executable unit?**
4. **What verification runs before merge/release?**
5. **What is the rollback plan?** (required for COSTLY/IRREVERSIBLE)
6. **Who approves?** (name + role)
```

Missing any field → remain in `WAIT`.

---

## Delay Duration Guidelines

| Reversibility | Minimum deliberation |
|---------------|---------------------|
| REVERSIBLE | 24 hours (one sleep cycle) |
| COSTLY | 72 hours + second reviewer |
| IRREVERSIBLE | 7 days + experiment completed |

These are floors, not ceilings.

---

## Anti-Patterns (Auto-BLOCK)

- "Let's just try it"
- "The tool recommended this"
- "We can refactor later" (without DEC-XXX accepting debt)
- "Everyone agrees" (without documented alternatives)
- "Ship and learn" (without falsification criteria)
- "It's obvious" (without evidence links)

---

## Integration

| Component | Integration |
|-----------|-------------|
| Clarification Protocol | Stage 8 requires CLEAR status |
| Governance | Approval gates check engine state |
| Self-Improvement | Reflection loop analyzes premature EXECUTING entries |

```json
  "justification": "required if to=CLEAR or to=EXECUTING"
}
```

# Argument Compiler v1.0.0

Converts conversation into a replayable argument graph where every conclusion is traceable.

---

## Pipeline

```text
conversation (raw)
       ↓
  [1] SEGMENT     — utterances → turns → topics
       ↓
  [2] EXTRACT     — atomic claims (CLM-XXX)
       ↓
  [3] LABEL       — KNOWN | INFERRED | UNKNOWN | SPECULATIVE
       ↓
  [4] EVIDENCE    — link EVD-XXX to claims
       ↓
  [5] ASSUME      — surface ASM-XXX attached to claims
       ↓
  [6] COUNTER     — extract CTR-XXX opposing claims
       ↓
  [7] VERIFY      — attach verification requirements (VER-XXX)
       ↓
  [8] RESOLVE     — decision node (DEC-XXX) or open question (OQ-XXX)
       ↓
argument graph (structured + auditable)
```

---

## Node Types

| Type | ID Pattern | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| Claim | CLM-XXX | Atomic proposition (one idea) |
| Evidence | EVD-XXX | Observable support or refutation |
| Assumption | ASM-XXX | Unverified premise claim depends on |
| Counterargument | CTR-XXX | Claim that contradicts or weakens CLM |
| Verification | VER-XXX | Test required to promote epistemic status |
| Decision | DEC-XXX | Resolved choice |
| Open Question | OQ-XXX | Unresolved — blocks decision |
| Actor | ACT-XXX | Who asserted or owns |

---

## Edge Types

| Edge | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `supports` | EVD → CLM |
| `refutes` | EVD → CLM |
| `assumes` | CLM → ASM |
| `contradicts` | CLM ↔ CLM |
| `requires` | CLM → VER |
| `resolves` | DEC → OQ |
| `derives` | CLM → CLM (inference) |
| `rejects` | DEC → CLM (alternative not chosen) |

---

## Compilation Rules

1. **Atomic claims only** — split compound sentences
2. **No orphan conclusions** — every DEC must have ≥1 supporting CLM chain
3. **Assumptions are explicit** — if removed, which claims break?
4. **Counterarguments mandatory** — for any DEC with reversibility ≥ COSTLY
5. **Epistemic promotion** — SPECULATIVE → KNOWN only via VER pass
6. **Replay hash** — graph + source transcript hash stored together

`cos/schema/argument-graph.schema.json` (see templates for instance)

```json
  "source": { "type": "conversation", "ref": "transcript.md", "hash": "sha256:..." },
  "compiledAt": "ISO-8601",
  "nodes": [],
  "edges": [],
  "conclusion": { "type": "DEC|OQ", "ref": "DEC-001" },
  "replay": { "compilerVersion": "1.0.0", "manualOverrides": [] }
}
```

Overrides are permitted but must be logged:

```json
{
  "nodeId": "CLM-003",
  "field": "epistemicStatus",
  "from": "SPECULATIVE",
  "to": "INFERRED",
  "reason": "Domain expert judgment — see EVD-007",
  "actor": "name",
  "timestamp": "ISO-8601"
}
```

| Check | Fail Action |

| Decision without rejected alternative | Reject graph |
| Claim without epistemic label | Reject graph |
| Circular derivation (CLM→CLM loop) | Flag for review |
| Evidence without source ref | Reject graph |
| Conclusion reachable without evidence path | Mark OQ, not DEC |

- Video research → argument backbone for script

# Thesis Compiler v1.0.0

Converts chaotic information dumps into structured thesis documents optimized for research, architecture, AI systems, videos, and technical writing.

---

## Input Types

- Research notes
- Tool outputs (search, AI, analytics)
- Meeting transcripts
- Architecture brainstorms
- Raw ideas and conversation exports

---

## Output Structure

Every compiled thesis contains exactly these sections:

```text
1. Core Thesis
2. Supporting Claims
3. Evidence
4. Assumptions
5. Dependencies
6. Failure Modes
7. Open Questions
8. Recommended Actions
```

---

## Compilation Pipeline

```text
raw dump
  → [DEDUPE]     remove redundant statements
  → [EXTRACT]    identify candidate thesis sentences
  → [RANK]       score by centrality to problem
  → [COMPILE]    assemble eight sections
  → [LABEL]      epistemic status on every claim
  → [LINK]       cross-reference to evidence
  → [GATE]       flag if Open Questions > Recommended Actions
  → thesis document
```

---

## Section Rules

### 1. Core Thesis

- Exactly **one** sentence
- Declarative, not interrogative
- Must be falsifiable
- Must not contain tool names unless tool is the subject

### 2. Supporting Claims

- 3–7 claims maximum
- Each independently testable
- Ordered by dependency (foundational first)

### 3. Evidence

- Each entry: source, date, excerpt, epistemic weight (strong/moderate/weak)
- Tool outputs labeled: `sourceType: tool` — never auto-promoted to KNOWN

### 4. Assumptions

- Numbered, explicit
- Each linked to claims it enables
- Flag `high_risk` if falsification would invalidate core thesis

### 5. Dependencies

- Upstream / downstream / hidden
- Status: verified | unverified | unknown

### 6. Failure Modes

- Reference `cos/frameworks/failure-analysis.md` classes
- Minimum one; prefer root cause over symptom

### 7. Open Questions

- Unresolved items blocking confidence
- Each assigned owner (or `unassigned` → blocks Stage 8)

### 8. Recommended Actions

- Ordered by: clarify → verify → experiment → execute
- Each action maps to a clarification stage
- **Max 3 execute-level actions** without new DEC

---

| Gate | Rule |
|------|------|
| Thesis clarity | Core thesis readable in one breath |
| Evidence ratio | ≥1 evidence per supporting claim |
| Assumption budget | Assumptions ≤ supporting claims |
| Action discipline | No execute actions if Open Questions > 0 (unless waived) |
| Entropy check | Output shorter than input (compression achieved) |

| `architecture` | Dependencies + Failure Modes expanded |

| `technical-writing` | All sections balanced, citation-heavy |

# Failure Analysis Framework v1.0.0

Standardized root-cause analysis. Identify **classes** of failure, not symptoms.

---

## Failure Taxonomy

| Class | ID | Definition | Root Cause Questions |
|-------|-----|------------|---------------------|
| **Architectural** | FAIL-ARCH | Structural design cannot satisfy constraints | Wrong boundaries? Missing abstraction? Coupling? |
| **Coordination** | FAIL-COORD | Agents/humans/systems fail to align | Unclear ownership? Missing protocol? Race? |
| **State** | FAIL-STATE | State corrupted, lost, or inconsistent | No SSOT? Concurrent write? Migration error? |
| **Memory** | FAIL-MEM | Retention, retrieval, or context wrong | Wrong tier? Eviction? Stale cache treated as truth? |
| **Verification** | FAIL-VERIFY | False confidence; checks insufficient | No falsification? Confirmation bias? |
| **Governance** | FAIL-GOV | Process bypassed or undefined | Skipped gate? No audit? Unclear authority? |
| **Replay** | FAIL-REPLAY | Cannot reconstruct past execution | Missing events? Non-determinism? No log? |
| **Context** | FAIL-CTX | Information loss in context assembly | Overflow? Bad compression? Wrong retrieval? |

---

## Analysis Template

For each failure incident or predicted failure mode:

```markdown
## Failure Record: FAIL-REC-{id}

### Symptom
What was observed? (user-visible)

### Class
FAIL-ARCH | FAIL-COORD | FAIL-STATE | FAIL-MEM | FAIL-VERIFY | FAIL-GOV | FAIL-REPLAY | FAIL-CTX

### Root Cause
Why did this class manifest? (one primary cause)

### Contributing Factors
Secondary conditions that amplified failure

### Detection Signal
How would we know earlier next time?

### Prevention
Structural change (not "be more careful")

### Replay Requirement
Can we reconstruct? If not, what must be logged?

### Constitutional Violation
Which primitive was violated? (Truth, Verification, State, Replay, etc.)
```

---

## Class-Specific Diagnostic Trees

### Architectural Failure

```text
Symptom: system doesn't scale / can't extend
  → Wrong service boundary?
  → Missing event log?
  → Synchronous coupling where async required?
  → Stateful logic in stateless layer?
```

### Coordination Failure

```text
Symptom: duplicate work / conflicting outputs
  → No single writer?
  → Missing idempotency?
  → Ambiguous ownership?
  → Race without conflict resolution?
```

### State Failure

```text
Symptom: data wrong after operation
  → Write without transaction?
  → Optimistic UI without rollback?
  → Schema drift?
  → Partial failure not compensated?
```

### Memory Failure

```text
Symptom: agent "forgot" or hallucinated context
  → Working memory overflow?
  → Retrieval ranked wrong?
  → Episodic conflated with semantic?
  → Cache served as authoritative?
```

### Verification Failure

```text
Symptom: shipped broken / false positive pass
  → Test doesn't match production path?
  → No negative test cases?
  → Manual QA only?
  → Metric measures activity not outcome?
```

### Governance Failure

```text
Symptom: decision untraceable / rework
  → Stage skipped?
  → No DEC record?
  → Tool output accepted without review?
  → Irreversible action without experiment?
```

### Replay Failure

```text
Symptom: cannot debug / audit / reproduce
  → Non-deterministic inputs not captured?
  → Events not append-only?
  → Clock/randomness unseeded?
  → Logs incomplete?
```

### Context Failure

```text
Symptom: reasoning degraded mid-task
  → Context window exceeded?
  → Compression lossy without verification?
  → Irrelevant retrieval injected?
  → Critical evidence evicted?
```

---

## Severity Matrix

| Severity | Impact | Required Response |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| S1 Critical | Data loss, irreversible harm | Halt execution, incident review |
| S2 Major | Wrong decision propagated | Block downstream, revise thesis |
| S3 Moderate | Rework required | Log, fix in next cycle |
| S4 Minor | Inconvenience | Track in consolidation |

---

## Integration

- **Stage 5** of Clarification Protocol requires failure class enumeration
- **Self-Improvement** reflection loop categorizes past decisions by failure class
- **VOS FD-03, FD-04, FD-07** visually express these classes — COS defines them

Active entropy prevention through gates, audits, and deprecation discipline.

### Review Gate (RG)

**Purpose:** Ensure artifact quality before promotion.

# Self-Improvement Framework v1.0.0

COS must continuously improve without losing replayability, history, reasoning, auditability, or traceability.

---

## Reflection Loop

**Cadence:** After every EXEC COMPLETE + monthly aggregate review

### Process

```text
1. COLLECT   — decisions, failures, overrides from audit log
2. CLASSIFY  — failure taxonomy + constitutional violations
3. ANALYZE   — premature execution? skipped stages? pattern?
4. PROPOSE   — specific improvement (template, gate, rule)
5. VERIFY    — improvement tested on past case (replay)
6. ADOPT     — amendment or artifact update with version bump
7. ARCHIVE   — superseded version with pointer
```

`cos/templates/reflection-record.template.md`

---

## Drift Detection

Automated and manual checks for:

| Drift Type | Detection Signal |
|------------|------------------|
| Terminology drift | Same concept, different labels across artifacts |
| Rule drift | Process behavior ≠ documented protocol |
| Constitutional drift | Decisions violating primitives without AMEND |
| Template drift | Artifacts not matching current schema |
| VOS grammar drift | Visual meanings redefined (COS must block) |

**Response:** Consolidation cycle or constitutional amendment — never silent fix.

---

## Quality Scoring

Score artifacts 1–5 on each dimension:

| Dimension | Question |
|-----------|----------|
| Clarity | Understandable in one read? |
| Traceability | Links to evidence complete? |
| Replayability | Can reconstruct from sources? |
| Completeness | All required sections present? |
| Economy | No redundant content? |

**Aggregate score** = minimum dimension score (weakest link).

|-------|--------|
| 5 | Promote as exemplar |
| 4 | Keep |
| 3 | Revise in next cycle |
| 2 | Merge or refactor |
| 1 | Archive, replace |

**Cadence:** Monthly or when duplicate detection triggers

| **MERGE** | Two artifacts >70% semantic overlap |
| **ARCHIVE** | Superseded, score ≤2, or unused 90+ days |

# Delayed Execution Engine v1.0.0

## Principle

The default state of every proposal is:

```text
WAIT
```

not

```text
BUILD
```

Execution is the exception. Delay is the safeguard.

---

## Engine States

| State | Meaning | Allowed Actions |
|-------|---------|-----------------|
| **WAIT** | Default. Insufficient clarity or verification | Clarify, research, experiment |
| **BLOCKED** | Active blocker identified | Resolve blocker only |
| **CLEAR** | All gates passed | Execution may be authorized |
| **EXECUTING** | Approved work in progress | Monitor, verify |
| **COMPLETE** | Verified done | Archive, reflect |
| **REVISE** | Verification failed | Return to appropriate stage |

---

## Automatic BLOCK Triggers

The engine enters `BLOCKED` when any condition is true:

| Trigger | Detection Signal | Return Stage |
|---------|------------------|--------------|
| Requirements unclear | Success criteria fail Stage 1 review | 1 |
| Assumptions exceed evidence | Assumption count > KNOWN evidence count | 2 |
| State incomplete | Required state artifacts missing | 4 |
| Dependencies unknown | Hidden deps list empty or "TBD" | 4 |
| Verification missing | No falsification criteria | 6 |
| Replay impossible | No audit path from inputs to conclusion | 6 |
| Tool-driven decision | Rationale cites tool output as sole authority | 2 |
| Context collapse risk | Reasoning depth > externalized state depth | 2 |
| Unowned problem | No stakeholder owner | 1 |

---

## Execution Justification Requirement

To transition `WAIT → CLEAR`, author must complete:

```markdown
## Execution Justification (required)

1. **Why now?** (not "because we can")
2. **What happens if we wait?** (cost of delay — must be evidence-based)
3. **What is the smallest executable unit?**
4. **What verification runs before merge/release?**
5. **What is the rollback plan?** (required for COSTLY/IRREVERSIBLE)
6. **Who approves?** (name + role)
```

Missing any field → remain in `WAIT`.

---

## Delay Duration Guidelines

| Reversibility | Minimum deliberation |
|---------------|---------------------|
| REVERSIBLE | 24 hours (one sleep cycle) |
| COSTLY | 72 hours + second reviewer |
| IRREVERSIBLE | 7 days + experiment completed |

- "Ship and learn" (without falsification criteria)
